newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cabinet to debate 98 budget outline Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Polish cabinet to debate 98 budget outline Tuesday.

text.p: The Polish government will discuss an outline of the 1998 national budget draft on Tuesday, the government spokeswoman Aleksandra Jakubowska said on Monday.
"The budget's outline will be discussed at a cabinet session on Tuesday," she told a news briefing.
Finance Minister Marek Belka has said the 1998 budget draft will assume that inflation will fall to 9.5 percent next year from 14.6 percent in May and that the economy will grow at 5.5 percent.

He has said the public debt, now at around 50 percent of gross domestic product, will be lowered by two points and budget deficit curbed to below two percent of GDP from 2.8 percent planned for this year.
